name: Signature
pose: He stands with weight grounded and even, shoulders squared to the camera, chin level, a focused and steady gaze — a disciplined, battle-ready stance, his expression calm and controlled, breath visible in the cold air.
effects: Fine snowflakes drift and swirl gently in the cold air around him, catching the torchlight.

components.companion: his bonded Frost Owl, a great owl with ice-pale feathers and glowing blue eyes, perched nearby watching the scene

notes: First-pass minimal signature scene — reuses the tank-group default wardrobe set + the existing castle background.
